StepDescription: Navigate to Lorenzo login page and enter username
Enter password
Click Login button to authenticate
Click on My Work tab to access task pane
Click Inpatient in My Work task pane
Click on Wards to expand ward list
Select Ward A from the ward list
Click OK to confirm ward selection
Wait for IP pegboard grid to load
Click Book to initiate IP bed booking for new patient
Generate random surname for new patient registration
Enter generated surname in patient search field
Click Find to search for existing patient
Click Registration link to register new patient
Enter city in patient registration form
Select country in patient registration form
Click Finish now to complete patient registration
Handle NHS allocation popup - click Yes
Handle NHS previous number popup - click No
Cancel additional popup dialog
Select ward in IP booking search criteria
Click Check Availability to find available beds
Select the first available bed row
Click Next to proceed to booking details
Select intended management for ward booking
Click Create Referral link to add referral to booking
Select service type for referral
Select referral priority
Select referral type
Select referral source
Click Finish now to complete referral creation
Click Finish now to complete IP ward booking
Validate booking row exists in IP pegboard confirming successful booking
-- ADMIT PATIENT --
Click Admit in task pane to initiate patient admission
Select admission source
Select admission type
Select intended management for admission
Click Next to proceed to admission road map
Click Care Provider SFS icon to search for care provider
Enter care provider identifier
Click Find to search for care provider
Click Ok to select care provider
Select ward for admission
Select bed category for admission
Click Finish now to complete patient admission
Close coding favourites dialog if present
Click Finish in coding screen to complete admission workflow
-- NAVIGATE TO HEALTH ISSUES EPR VIEW --
Select admitted patient row in IP pegboard to activate context pane
Click View EPR link to open the patient Electronic Patient Record
Wait for EPR view to load
Click Health Issues EPR tab to navigate to Alerts and Allergies section
Wait for Health Issues section to load
-- RECORD ALERT --
Click Alerts tab to navigate to Alerts list
Wait for Alerts list to load
Click Record Alert context pane link to initiate alert recording
Wait for Record Alert wizard to load
Select alert type
Select alert name
Click Add to add the alert
Click Finish now to save the recorded alert
Wait for return to Alerts list after recording
Validate Alerts tab is visible confirming alert was saved in List View
Validate alert list view is loaded with inactive filter option confirming alert record exists
-- MODIFY ALERT --
Click Alerts tab to reload Alerts list
Wait for Alerts list to reload
Click Modify Alert context pane link
Wait for Modify Alert wizard to load
Update information source field during alert modification
Click Finish now to save modified alert details
Wait for return to Alerts list after modification
Validate Alerts tab is visible confirming updated alert details are saved in List View
Validate alert list view is loaded confirming updated alert record is present
-- CLOSE ALERT --
Click Alerts tab to reload Alerts list for Close operation
Wait for Alerts list to reload
Click Close Alert context pane link
Wait for Close Alert wizard to load
Select reason to close the alert
Click Finish to save closed alert
Wait for return to Alerts list after closing
Click Display inactive alert checkbox to show closed Inactive alert in list
Wait for inactive alerts to appear in list
Validate Alerts tab is visible confirming closed alert is shown in List View
Validate inactive alert filter is active confirming alert status is Inactive
-- RE-OPEN ALERT --
Click Alerts tab to reload Alerts list for Re-open operation
Wait for Alerts list to reload
Click Display inactive alert to ensure inactive alert is visible for re-open
Wait for inactive alert to appear in list
Click Re-open Alert context pane link
Wait for Re-open Alert wizard to load
Select reason to re-open the alert
Click Finish to save re-opened alert
Wait for return to Alerts list after re-opening
Validate Alerts tab is visible confirming re-opened alert status is Active in List View
Validate alert list view is loaded confirming alert is now Active
-- STRIKE ALERT --
Click Alerts tab to reload Alerts list for Strike operation
Wait for Alerts list to reload
Click Strikeout Alert context pane link
Wait for Strikeout Alert wizard to load
Select reason to strike out the alert
Click Confirm checkbox to confirm strike out
Click Finish to save struck out alert
Wait for return to Alerts list after strike out
Click Display struck out alert checkbox to show struck out alert in list
Wait for struck out alert to appear in list
Validate struck out alert filter is active confirming alert strike out details are saved
-- RECORD ALLERGY/ADR --
Click Allergies/ADRs tab to navigate to Allergy list
Wait for Allergies/ADRs list to load
Click Record Allergy/ADR context pane link to initiate allergy recording
Wait for Record Allergy wizard to load
Select allergy type
Enter allergen name
Select information source for the allergy
Click Add to add the allergy/ADR
Click Finish now to save the recorded allergy
Wait for return to Allergies list after recording
Validate Allergies/ADRs tab is visible confirming allergy was saved in List View
Validate allergy list view is loaded with inactive filter confirming allergy record exists
-- MODIFY ALLERGY/ADR --
Click Allergies/ADRs tab to reload Allergy list
Wait for Allergies/ADRs list to reload
Click Modify Allergy/ADR context pane link
Wait for Modify Allergy wizard to load
Update onset date during allergy modification
Click Finish now to save modified allergy details
Wait for return to Allergies list after modification
Validate Allergies/ADRs tab is visible confirming updated allergy details are saved in List View
Validate allergy list view is loaded confirming updated allergy record is present
-- CLOSE ALLERGY/ADR --
Click Allergies/ADRs tab to reload Allergy list for Close operation
Wait for Allergies/ADRs list to reload
Click Close Allergy/ADR context pane link
Wait for Close Allergy wizard to load
Select reason to close the allergy
Click Finish to save closed allergy
Wait for return to Allergies list after closing
Click Display inactive allergies checkbox to show closed Inactive allergy in list
Wait for inactive allergies to appear in list
Validate Allergies/ADRs tab is visible confirming closed allergy is shown in List View
Validate inactive allergy filter is active confirming allergy status is Inactive
-- RE-OPEN ALLERGY/ADR --
Click Allergies/ADRs tab to reload Allergy list for Re-open operation
Wait for Allergies/ADRs list to reload
Click Display inactive allergies to ensure inactive allergy is visible for re-open
Wait for inactive allergy to appear in list
Click Re-open Allergy/ADR context pane link
Wait for Re-open Allergy wizard to load
Select reason to re-open the allergy
Click Finish to save re-opened allergy
Wait for return to Allergies list after re-opening
Validate Allergies/ADRs tab is visible confirming re-opened allergy status is Active in List View
Validate allergy list view is loaded confirming allergy is now Active
-- STRIKE ALLERGY/ADR --
Click Allergies/ADRs tab to reload Allergy list for Strike operation
Wait for Allergies/ADRs list to reload
Click Strikeout Allergy/ADR context pane link
Wait for Strikeout Allergy wizard to load
Select reason to strike out the allergy
Click Confirm checkbox to confirm allergy strike out
Click Finish to save struck out allergy
Wait for return to Allergies list after strike out
Click Display struck out allergies checkbox to show struck out allergy in list
Wait for struck out allergy to appear in list
Validate struck out allergy filter is active confirming allergy strike out details are saved
-- LOGOUT --
Click Logout button to end the session
Validate login page is displayed confirming successful logout
